title: Coefficient-unit change commutes with normalized etale locality
statement: Let P be the finite purity setting [def-pur-conventions], N a normalized etale compact-support datum [def-sp-etale-compact-support-normalization], and U,X,Y Noetherian schemes. Let j:U→X be separated, quasi-compact, locally finite type and etale. Let f:X→Y, h:U→Y be compactifiable, with j≫f compactifiable and he:j≫f=h. Write unitChange for the specified isomorphism from monoidal-unit dualizing objects to degree-zero coefficient dualizing objects [def-pur-diagonal-counit-comparison-data], and write structural locality for the counit-normalized etale locality [lem-trf-section-exceptional-fibre-coherence]. Then j*(unitChange_f), followed by diagonalEtaleLocality(N,j,f) and diagonalDualizingCongr(he) [def-pur-diagonal-dualizing-data], equals structural locality for (j,f,h,he) followed by unitChange_h. No smoothness, rank, nonemptiness or affine-open hypothesis is needed.

source.place: Steps 1--2 and final canonicity paragraph; orientation-charts proof Step 3

proof.text: The natural isomorphism given by the derived/exact pullback comparison followed by tensorMateEtalePrecompLocalityIso, evaluated on the monoidal unit, is structural locality by locality_tensorMate. Apply naturality of its hom transformation to the inverse of singleFunctorObjUnitIso. Its exceptional image is exactly unitChange, while the coefficient-object component is diagonalEtaleLocality.

Substitute the equality he:j≫f=h. The equality-congruence isomorphism becomes the identity and the naturality equation gives the stated equality of isomorphisms. This is valid for empty schemes as well.

lean.statement:
theorem diagonalEtaleLocality_unitChange (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u})
    (N : Etale.EtaleCompactSupportNormalization P.Coefficient)
    {U X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian U] [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian Y]
    (j : U ⟶ X) [Etale j] [IsSeparated j] [LocallyOfFiniteType j] [QuasiCompact j]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [HasCompactification f] [HasCompactification (j ≫ f)]
    (h : U ⟶ Y) [HasCompactification h] (he : j ≫ f = h) :
    (Etale.ordinaryFinitePullback P.Coefficient j).mapIso
        (OrientationCounit.unitChange P f) ≪≫
      P.diagonalEtaleLocality N j f ≪≫ P.diagonalDualizingCongr he =
    Etale.sectionStructuralLocalityIso P.Coefficient j f h he ≪≫
      OrientationCounit.unitChange P h
